name: Jubilant Pharmova
about: Jubilant Pharmova Ltd. is a leading global pharmaceutical company involved in diverse business segments, including radiopharma, allergy immunotherapy, CDMO sterile injectables, CRDMO, generics, and proprietary novel drugs. The company manufactures and supplies radiopharmaceuticals through a network of 46 radiopharmacies in the US, and its allergy immunotherapy business produces allergy extracts and venom products for markets like the US, Canada, and Europe. Jubilant’s CDMO sterile injectables segment provides manufacturing services, while its CRDMO business focuses on drug discovery and API manufacturing. Jubilant Therapeutics, its novel drugs division, develops breakthrough therapies in oncology and autoimmune disorders. The company operates six global manufacturing facilities.
